Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1171
Claimant:
Thomas Harmon
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
8-6-24
Claim received today for a left-turn collision at an intersection involving the insured's vehicle and a second vehicle.
The claimant reports a knee injury from the impact and is not represented by an attorney.
8-18-24
Confirmed the driver is listed on the policy and that the policy was in force at the time of the loss. Covergae appears
in order for this claim.
8-30-24
Spoke with the claimant, who described the crash as a left turn that was struck on the driver's side by oncoming
traffic. The account was clear and consistent with the iintial report.
9-7-24
Police report reviewed. Officers confirm the claimant was seated in the vehicle when they arrived on scene.
9-8-24
Obtained photos from the scene and statements from two independent witnesses. Both describe the collision in the
same way the claimant did, and the other driver's account matches as well.
9-9-24
Reviewed vehicle damage with the appraiser. The damage is largely consistent with the impact described, and no
prior damage to the vehicle is known from our records or the claimant's history.
10-21-24
Checked the vehicle's claim and inspection history. Nothing points to damage that existed before the coverage start
date.
11-29-24
Medical records received for the knee injury. The type of injury and the force involved in the crash line up well with
one another.
12-27-24
Claimant's treatment has continued for somewhat longer than is typical for this kind of knee injury. Requested the
treating provider's notes to understand the course of care.
1-11-25
Prior records show a minor strain in the same knee area several years ago. That episode resolved fully with treatment
and has no bearing on the current injury based on the medical review so far.
2-8-25
Every conversation with the claimant has produced the same account of events and injuries. Claim remains open
pending the final medical review and a settlement evaluation.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
